relationships.publicationGuard: Require independently documented complicated or perforated appendicitis, relevant pelvic or tubal pathology, a separately established female infertility diagnosis, compatible chronology, and gynecologic review. Preserve age, endometriosis, pelvic inflammatory disease, prior pelvic surgery, congenital factors, male-factor infertility, and other competing causes.

Require independently documented Arnold-Chiari malformation, separately diagnosed sleep apnea by polysomnography, explicit obstructive or central phenotype characterization, compatible chronology, and neurology and sleep-medicine review. Preserve adenotonsillar or upper-airway obstruction, obesity, craniofacial anatomy, pulmonary disease, medication effects, and other causes.

Require independently documented atrial flutter, a separately established ischemic cerebrovascular accident with objective residuals, compatible chronology, rhythm and anticoagulation records, and cardiovascular-neurologic review. Preserve atrial fibrillation, carotid or intracranial atherosclerosis, hypertension, diabetes, smoking, thrombophilia, structural heart disease, and other competing stroke causes.

Require independently documented burn injury with compatible depth and anatomic site, separately documented scar contracture or objective joint limitation, compatible chronology, and burn or rehabilitation specialist review. Preserve pre-existing joint disease, neurologic weakness, tendon injury, infection, immobilization, surgical effects, and other causes of restricted motion.
